headline: 秋季新樂與生活隨拍
context: 衛報整理了2026年秋季必聽的新專輯與巡演名單，強尼・馬爾（Johnny Marr）、菲比・布里吉斯（Phoebe Bridgers）都有新作品，鮑伯・狄倫（Bob Dylan）與凱拉（Kelela）則將開唱。另外，佛羅里達的崔斯・米克（Trace Meek）也分享了他跟太太花十年打造的後院照片。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Irish noisemongers Gilla Band, shadowy producers Two Shell and lovable band the Big Moon have new records, and there are tours from Bob Dylan and Kelela – plus the best of jazz, global and classical • ‘It’s easier when nobody’s watching’: inside the secretive and sublime freak-folk of @ • See all of our unmissable autumn arts recommendations here Continue reading...
sources.title: The best music of autumn 2026: Johnny Marr, Phoebe Bridgers, Rachel Chinouriri and more

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: A family day in a Florida back yard was the setting for a summertime memory it would be impossible to recreate Trace Meek is abundantly proud of his Florida back yard. For the last 10 years, he and his wife, Lauren, have worked diligently on it. “It’s our happy place,” he says. “We live in Belleair Bluffs, and I’ve watched my son and daughter grow up playing in the dirt under our giant oak trees, swinging on the tree swing, riding their bikes and scooters on the circular path, and swimming in our pool. It’s big, with a really deep end and three water fountains that shoot over the top. We like to have a last jump into the pool before bed and, best of all, there are no iPads or TVs.” The family had friends visiting for 4 July celebrations when Meek took this photo on his phone. There were six adults, six children and two dogs present. Harvey, a braque français, is pictured here on Lauren’s lap. Continue reading...

秋季新樂與生活隨拍

衛報整理了2026年秋季必聽的新專輯與巡演名單，強尼・馬爾（Johnny Marr）、菲比・布里吉斯（Phoebe Bridgers）都有新作品，鮑伯・狄倫（Bob Dylan）與凱拉（Kelela）則將開唱。

另外，佛羅里達的崔斯・米克（Trace Meek）也分享了他跟太太花十年打造的後院，一張狗、帽子和腳踝刺青恰好同框的照片，成了他心裡最喜歡的夏日回憶。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月 29 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 今年秋天有不少新專輯和巡演消息。強尼・馬爾、菲比・布里吉斯都有新作品，鮑伯・狄倫和凱拉則要開唱。另外，佛羅里達有位讀者崔斯・米克，分享了他跟太太花十年打造的後院，一張狗、帽子和腳踝刺青恰好同框的照片，成了他心裡最喜歡的夏日回憶。
